title: Parse a whole number
summary: Spring Boot: Parse a whole number. Try /double/cat.
introduction: An int path input is parsed by Spring. Open GET /double/4. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Parse a whole number with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Parse a whole number

blocks.text: Spring converts the path text 4 to an int before invoking the method. The product is 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A type checks the shape, not whether the number fits your business rule.

seo.title: Spring Boot: Parse a whole number
seo.description: Spring Boot: Parse a whole number. Try /double/cat. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
